Defense

AC 19, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+5 armor, +4 dex, +2 natural)

hp 30 [44] (4d8+12)

mp 12

Fort +3, Ref +7, Will +5

Defensive Abilities Hard Scale, Legless, Well-Versed; Resist Water 5;

Offense

Speed 5 ft., swim 50 ft.

Melee Rapier +5 (1d6+2/18-20)

Ranged Shortbow +6 (1d6/x3)

Special Abilities Bardic Performance (13 rounds/day), Countersong, Distraction, Fascinate (DC 15), Inspiration (2d6), Inspire Competence +2, Inspire Courage +1, Troubadour (3/day)

Special Attacks Dissonance (5/day, base DC 15)

Spells Known (Bard CL 4th, Concentration +7)

At will (DC 13) - Ghost Sound, Lullaby, Song of Serenity

1st (DC 14) - Army's Paeon, Elemental Carol, Elemental Threnody, Foe Requiem, Hideous Laughter, Inspirational Boost, Joyful Noise, Quick Etude, Sheepfoe Mambo

2nd (DC 15) - Lively Step, Silent Verse

Statistics

Str 14, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 12, Wis 12, Cha 16

Base Atk +3; CMB +5; CMD 18 (cannot be tripped)

Feats Extra MP, Improved Initiative

Skills Acrobatics +13, Bluff +13, Disguise +13, Perception +11, Perform (Harp) +13, Perform (Sing) +15, Spellcraft +11;

Languages Aquan, Common, Draconic

SQ Amphibious, Major Aura +1 (Steady Hand), Minor Aura (Force of Will, Watchful Eye), Seasinger, Trident Expert, Versatile Performance (Sing)

Gear cure potion (2), rapier, chain shirt, shortbow, 10 arrows, harp

effect: Perform DC 10 + target CR; margin changes duration, severity and DC (see class table). Shaken 1 round on base failure.
Successful Perform check: -2 to the triggering attack, escalating with margin per the class table.
Speed -5 ft; no running or charging. Resolve Perform against 10 + CR and higher-margin effects from the table.
Caster must check concentration at -2 against DC 15 + spell level or lose the spell. Resolve Perform against 10 + CR and higher-margin effects from the table.
Damage is halved on a successful Fortitude save. Margin of 5/10/20 raises dice to 2/3/4d6, respectively. Resolve Perform against 10 + CR and higher-margin effects from the table.
Sickened one round; at +5/+10/+20 margin: sickened three rounds, nauseated one round, nauseated three rounds. Resolve Perform against 10 + CR and higher-margin effects from the table.
Staggered one round; at +5/+10/+20 margin: staggered three rounds, dazed one round, dazed three rounds. Resolve Perform against 10 + CR and higher-margin effects from the table.

description.value: Defensive ability listed in the source statblock: Well-Versed.
Merfolk are amphibious, but prefer not to spend long periods out of the water.

contextNotes.text: Can breathe both air and water.
Can breathe both air and water.

description.value: Merfolk have a +2 natural armor bonus.
Merfolk have no legs, and therefore cannot be tripped.
The beautiful voices of the merfolk are legendary. A seasinger gains a +2 racial bonus on Perform (sing) checks and a +1 racial bonus to the save DC of charm and fascinated effect spells.

contextNotes.text: +2 Perform (sing); +1 to DC only for spells that charm or fascinate (not all enchantments or class performances).

description.value: Merfolk are proficient with tridents.
Only for a charm or fascination spell; not for ordinary mind-affecting spells or class abilities.

contextNotes.text: Only for a charm or fascination spell; not for ordinary mind-affecting spells or class abilities.

description.value: Bardic Performance

effect: Start one selected performance, or use Maintain for subsequent rounds. The mode's check/save does not spend a second round.
Maintain the current performance for one round.

description.value: Inspiration

effect: All allies gain [[2d6]] temporary HP until consumed or battle ends. May include self.

description.value: Countersong

effect: Perform (sing) [[1d20 + @skills.prf.subSkills.sing.mod]] may replace a save against sonic/language-dependent magic.

description.value: Distraction

effect: Use an eligible visual Perform check for a save against illusion pattern or figment effects; singing alone is not a visual performance.

description.value: Fascinate

effect: Must see and hear. On failure fascinated while performing; obvious threats end it. Successful save grants 24h immunity; Seasinger does not raise a non-spell DC.

description.value: Inspire Competence

effect: One ally who can see/hear gains +2 competence on a chosen skill while listening. Cannot target self.
